'''2001 Montreal DPC warm-up tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cosmos (store), Quebec on 17 August 2001. [[Raphael Asselin]] won it. It is known from Thomas Dowling's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2869">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-dpc-montreal-roadtrip-cotebs-viewd2869/ dpc-montreal-roadtrip-cotebs-view], DeckTech (Thomas "COTEB" Dowling, 19 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-19-dpc-montreal-roadtrip-cotebs-viewd2869/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Montreal DPC]].

* '''Date:''' 17 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Cosmos (store), Quebec
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Raphael Asselin]]
